# ChurchedIn

> A church-scoped platform connecting international students with local church volunteers through events, rides, and friend matching.

## About

ChurchedIn helps churches organize gatherings, coordinate rides, and connect international students with local friends. Students can browse events, RSVP, request rides, and find a friend at their church. Volunteers can host events, offer rides, and mentor students.

## Contact

- Website: https://churchedin.vercel.app
